top.title: Ryan Gosling's Band | Music Video Clipping
top.description: The goal of this campaign is simple: get people to watch the music video. Most of the internet does not know Ryan Gosling has a band, and the ones who do have not heard new music from it in 17 years. That gap is the whole opportunity.
top.brief: Just in time for the spooky season, Dead Man's Bones—the gothic indie-rock project consisting of Hollywood A-lister Ryan Gosling and filmmaker Zach Shields—has unexpectedly resurrected with "Lost in the Night", their first new single in 17 years. Released via ANTI- Records, the track brilliantly strips away the lush children's choir arrangements of their 2009 cult-classic debut in favor of a raw, low-fi aesthetic recorded in just one day at a rural farm outside Los Angeles. Produced alongside longtime collaborator Tim Anderson, the song meshes unvarnished post-punk guitars and moody synths with a driving 1970s synth-punk beat reminiscent of the band Suicide, perfectly capturing a bittersweet balance between shadowy gothic rock and arena-sized emotional hope. The accompanying black-and-white music video, starring Noah Jupe and Rain Spencer as a young couple escaping a cemetery to dance through lamplit city streets, serves as the ultimate atmospheric companion piece to a long-awaited comeback that proves this haunting duo is far from permanently buried.
